newsitem.title: CHINA: China steps up efforts to build highways, ports.
newsitem.headline: China steps up efforts to build highways, ports.

text.p: China's State Planning Commission on Thursday announced 18 key transport projects for 1997 as part of an effort to improve road, port and berth conditions.
The projects were aimed at increasing the handling capacity of freight and promoting China's import and export trade, the official Xinhua news agency quoted the commission as saying.
Included were port projects in Shanghai and Tianjin and highways from Beijing to Shenzhen and from Sichuan province to Tibet, the agency said.
China has 1.25 million km of roads, which are one of the major means linking different parts of the 9.6 million square km country, it said.
Xinhua said the Beijing-Shenzhen expressway would improve links between Shenzhen, the country's first special economic zone, and northern China.
It said that the Sichuan-Tibet highway would help promote economic prosperity in Tibet, one of China's poorest regions.
